definition:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Idle
  Idle --> Running : start
  state Running {
    [*] --> Fetching
    Fetching --> Transforming : rows
    Transforming --> Writing
    Writing --> [*]
  }
  Running --> Paused : pause
  Paused --> Running : resume
  Running --> Failed : error
  state choose <<choice>>
  Failed --> choose
  choose --> Running : retries left
  choose --> [*] : give up
  note right of Paused : checkpoint flushed
intent: stateDiagram-v2 with composite state, fork/join, choice, and notes
